real_name: BLA leader figure — partially real name
real_life_notes: Represents Balochistan Liberation Army (BLA) leadership. The BLA is a Baloch separatist militant group that has operated against Pakistan's state. The relationship between BLA and Indian intelligence is complex — Pakistani authorities have repeatedly alleged Indian RAW support for BLA, while India denies it. The film navigates this carefully: Shirani is likely depicted as an anti-Pakistan actor whose interests partially align with Hamza's mission but who is not under Indian direction.
film_role: Film 1/2 — represents the Baloch separatist dimension of Karachi's complex political landscape. Rehman Dakait (a Baloch) and the BLA occupy overlapping Lyari territory. Shirani's character creates the tension between criminal-ISI networks (Dakait) and separatist-ISI targets (BLA).
objective: Baloch self-determination; undermine Pakistani state authority; maintain BLA presence in Karachi's Baloch community; navigate ISI/criminal pressure
oracle_note: Shirani is a 'third-side' actor — he is neither on the Indian side nor part of the ISI-Dakait nexus. His presence adds complexity to the SNA power graph: he is a node that the oracle should weight differently from the ISI-criminal network.
